title: AFCON 2027: Gomes Da Rosa gives up on qualification chances

 Adamu Muftawu · Nov 17, 2026 Gomes Da Rosa: Picture credit. @CAFOnline/X Sierra Leone head coach Gomes Da Rosa has given up on qualifying for the 2027 Africa Cup of Nations and instead focused on playing for pride and honour.
 The Leone Stars are set to face DR Congo in matchday 4 on Tuesday, November 17, after suffering a 3-1  loss on day 3 on November 12.
 Having failed to clock a point in three opening matches in Group E, Gomes Da Rosa believes the time has come to earn at least a point before the final games in March next year.
 “Now, we won’t be playing for qualification, but for honour. We need to at least get a point tomorrow,” he said.
 Sierra Leone has zero points so far and sits at the bottom of Group E. Against DR Congo, the Leone Stars will therefore try to salvage their honour in front of their home fans.
 DR Congo lead the group on nine points, with Zimbabwe in second on seven points and Equatorial Guinea on four points.
